title: Free Women's Health Brigade Brings Cervical Cancer Screenings to Nuevo Laredo
excerpt: Sistema DIF Nuevo Laredo is offering free HPV and Pap tests, medical consultations, vaccinations and family planning services for women ages 25 to 64, from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. at DIF Central in Fraccionamiento Ojo Caliente.
content:
Sistema DIF Nuevo Laredo is joining with the Distrito de Salud para el Bienestar Número V to hold a free health brigade for women, offering cervical cancer detection tests, medical consultations, vaccinations and guidance on sexual and reproductive health, according to Oficina de Corresponsales.

The brigade is held in connection with the World Day for the Elimination of Cervical Cancer, observed Tuesday, Nov. 17. Women attending can receive free human papillomavirus (HPV) detection tests and Pap smears, general medical consultations, family planning guidance and methods, vaccinations, and tests to detect sexually transmitted diseases, according to the report.

The services are aimed at women ages 25 to 64, especially women without social security, according to Hoy Tamaulipas. The brigade runs from 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. at DIF Central, located at Héroe de Nacataz #2244 in Fraccionamiento Ojo Caliente.

DIF Nuevo Laredo Director General Roberto Viviano Vázquez Macías urged women to take advantage of the free services, saying prevention is fundamental to protecting their health and that getting the recommended tests can make a big difference, according to the report.

Claudette Canturosas Villarreal, president of the DIF Nuevo Laredo Patronato, reaffirmed the agency's commitment to women's health, prevention, timely detection and access to medical services, according to the report.

Cervical cancer is the second leading cause of death among women in Mexico, and when detected early it is curable in 99% of cases, according to Hoy Tamaulipas.

Sources: Oficina de Corresponsales, Nov. 16, 2026; Hoy Tamaulipas, Nov. 16, 2026.
